scripts.types: sh -c 'if [ -n "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" ]; then supabase gen types typescript --project-id "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" --schema public > src/types/supabase.ts; else supabase gen types typescript --linked --schema public > src/types/supabase.ts; fi'
scripts.prebuild: sh -c 'if [ -n "$SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN" ] && [ -n "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" ]; then npm run types; else echo Skipping Supabase typegen; fi'
scripts.db:reset:local: supabase db reset && npm run db:ensure-admin && npm run db:seed:local
